name: JPG2PDF
description: Open-source image to PDF converter for Linux. Batch convert JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, SVG & WebP into PDF with custom page size, DPI and AES-256 encryption. Python/PyQt5, MIT.

paragraphs: JPEG2PDF is a fast, offline image-to-PDF converter for Linux. Batch convert JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, SVG and WebP images into high-quality PDF documents — with page size and margin control, custom DPI, page numbering, rotation, grayscale output and AES-256 password protection. Everything runs locally; your images never leave your computer.
features: Batch convert — turn a whole folder of images into PDFs in one click.
One PDF or many — merge every image into a single document, or export one PDF per image.
Sort and reorder — sort by name, date modified, file size or date taken, drag images into any order, or move them to the top or bottom.
Ticked automatically — new images are ready to convert; click the ✓ column header to tick or untick all.
Page sizes — A4, A3, A5, Letter, Legal or any custom size, with automatic orientation.

requirements.text: There is no upload, no account, and no file-size limit — which matters if you are converting scanned IDs, contracts or medical records.
